goal: Marketing admissions live with Ed Admin as SIS and an approve-before-send agent loop

phases.name: Live gate
outcomes: Public /api/health/live reports blockers without leaking secrets
Staff /marketing/readiness lists phases and connection status
Placeholder API keys count as missing

phases.name: Recommend loop
outcomes: Queue of leads by vitality + next action
Propose draft WhatsApp / SMS / email / form link / mark dead
Approve or reject with an audit row — send only after approve

phases.name: SIS reads
outcomes: Occupancy counts from StudentClasses — no names stored
Graceful skip when the General API key is absent

phases.name: Smoke + loop engineering
outcomes: npm run test:live covers login, leads, contacts, webhooks, agent approve, readiness
Approve without SMTP/AT records skipped, not sent

phases.name: Human cutover
outcomes: Give Ed Admin WEBHOOK_SECRET and prove one application-submitted
SMTP + Africa's Talking for real messages
